description:
I got the idea from Swaggy's video where he rushes Feudal Age with Great Pastures to make iron pagodas very early.
But, since iron pagodas take so long to produce, I decided to make horsemen first instead before transitioning to mohe tribesmen.

The goal is to mess up the opponent's plan faster than any other civilization can, blocking resources and forcing them to react by spending resources on spearmen and archers.

This doesn't work against civilizations with heavy cavalry in Feudal Age (French, Jeanne D'Arc, Rus or Golden Horde). It also doesn't work against English, Lancaster or Abbasyd (military wing).

Check my other Jin Dinasty guides:
- 2 TC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/cVmyoYJZ7MFxVg1MGiu8

You might need to force drop @resource/resource_food.webp@ again to not idle @building_economy/town-center.webp@
After second @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ is out, make @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ (wait a bit for excess @resource/resource_food.webp@)
If you expect pressure on your @resource/resource_gold.webp@, build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ or @building_defensive/outpost.webp@
Keep producing @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@. Also, make @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ with @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@ and @building_jin/grassland.webp@ discount.

4 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ is more than enough to produce units and any building you might need.
Only add more if you want to add @building_economy/farm.webp@ early. Otherwise @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ and @resource/resource_gold.webp@

description:
As basic as possible Jin build order for new players making the most of the unique Jin cavalry. Video below!

The gameplan is Feudal aggression with Horsemen + Iron Pagoda + Mohe Tribesmen. The goal is to contain and raid your opponent, picking up villager kills when possible while taking deer/boar behind. It's a bit micro intensive for new players but very fun!

It's difficult to Feudal all-in as Jin so you'll often look to turn your advantage into a strong Castle Age timing, and perhaps even fast Imp (see below video!)

Good luck!
name: New Player Guide to Jin Dynasty
author: Shaada

Send 5 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/deer.webp@/@resource/boar.webp@. Be aggressive, raiding and containing your opponent while taking map control.
